title: Musica
description:
Turn your living room into the ultimate game show stage! A fast-paced, local multiplayer party game where you test your musical knowledge against your friends. No need to buy extra controllers—everyone plays using their own smartphones!

📱 Use Your Phone as a Controller!Simply start the game on your PC, scan the QR code on the screen, and instantly join the lobby from your phone's web browser. It's seamless, fast, and supports up to 4 teams or any number of players.

🎮 Three Exciting Game Modes:• Guess That Song: Listen to a track and be the first to buzz in! But be careful—wrong answers will cost you 250 points, and your potential points drain away the longer you wait.

• Before or After: Build a musical timeline! Listen to a song and decide if it was released before or after the songs already on the board.

• Time Survival: A high-stakes trivia battle where points are your health bar. Answer correctly to survive, but make a mistake and watch your score disappear!

✨ Key Features:• Local Party Multiplayer: Perfect for parties, family gatherings, or just hanging out.

• Endless replayability with a massive catalog of over 2,000 hit songs!

• Test your knowledge across thousands of tracks covering decades of music!

• Team Mode: Group up and compete together in teams!

• Fully Bilingual: Play the entire game in either English or Arabic!
description_short: Gather your friends for the ultimate musical showdown! Connect your phones as controllers and compete in three exciting modes: Guess That Song, Before or After, and Time Survival. Test your musical knowledge, buzz in fast, and see who truly rules the aux cord in this local party game!
